encode_sentences_with_LaserSentenceEncod: encode a list of text sentences into numpy embeddings using LaserSentenceEncoder with SPM tokenization
build_SentenceEncoder_for_batch_encoding: build a SentenceEncoder from a model checkpoint to batch encode sentences into fixed-length embeddings
create_LaserTransformerEncoder_from_chec: create a LaserTransformerEncoder that extracts sentence embeddings using CLS token or max pooling from a fairseq checkpoint
run_LaserLstmEncoder_forward_pass: run a forward pass through a bidirectional LSTM encoder to produce sentence embeddings via max pooling
gather_spm_model_and_vocab: gather the SPM model and vocab file paths from an encoder model path using LaserSentenceEncoder.gather_spm
